name: obsidian-vault-doctor
description: Obsidian vault diagnosis and restructure expert: read-only health check, broken-link/orphan/duplicate detection, prioritized A/B/C action plan, safe file moves with automatic link rewriting and one-command rollback. Runs entirely on the user's machine with zero dependencies.

displayDescription.zh: Obsidian 库诊断与管理：扫描库结构，甄别真问题与正常现象，输出健康分与分级清单，全程可回滚。
displayDescription.en: Diagnose and manage your Obsidian vault: structural scans, real-issue detection, health score, graded plan, fully reversible.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 给我的 Obsidian 笔记库做个体检，看看有什么不健康的地方
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run a full diagnostic on my Obsidian vault and flag anything unhealthy

quickPrompts.en: Run a full diagnostic on my Obsidian vault and flag anything unhealthy
quickPrompts.zh: 给我的 Obsidian 笔记库做个体检，看看有什么不健康的地方

quickPrompts.en: My vault has hundreds of notes with a messy structure. Give me a systematic entry point and execution order
quickPrompts.zh: 库内笔记数量庞大且结构混乱，给出系统性的整理切入点与执行顺序

quickPrompts.en: Restructure this folder, rewrite all references across the vault, and keep everything reversible
quickPrompts.zh: 重组指定目录结构，自动重写全库引用链接，并确保全程可回滚
